Topic.label: Estimating population counts using sample percentages

Question: To estimate the proportion of students in a school who are nearsighted, which of the following methods gives the most reliable result?

Choices.A: Survey 200 students outside an eyeglass store
Choices.D: Survey only students who failed a vision screening

Solution: Reliable estimation requires randomness and an appropriate sample size. Surveying students outside an eyeglass store or surveying only those who failed a vision screening introduces bias, while a sample of 20 students is too small.
